# Axe: a heavy wood haft 0.72 m with a broad steel head on one side. Grip at the origin, head up.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Haft --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 0.4275 0.4471 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Edge --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Haft --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.200
scale 0.080 0.080 0.720
apply --scale
material assign Haft
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.150 0.000 0.470
scale 0.240 0.070 0.240
apply --scale
material assign Head
add mesh cube --name Edge --size 1 --location 0.300 0.000 0.470
scale 0.080 0.070 0.340
apply --scale
material assign Edge
select all
shade flat
export axe.glb
